wikipedia: Protectorate General to Pacify the East

predecessors.name: Goguryeo
predecessors.text: Goguryeo's territory in Manchuria and the northern Korean peninsula: 'divided into 9 commanderies, 42 prefectures, and 100 counties' (the 667 outline is the last full one)

successors.name: Silla
successors.text: 'Silla took all the territory south of the Taedong River' (676): Hwanghae and Gyeonggi are the Goguryeo-held lands south of it

ledger.x: December 668: the Tang divide Goguryeo into the Protectorate.
676: Silla takes the land south of the Taedong.

wars.name: Goguryeo revolts against the Protectorate
wars.outcome: 'the first revolt of the people of Goguryeo took place in 669' and from 670 to 673 'the rebels launched an uprising every year, the last of which lasted for four years'; the Tang held the northern lands.

wars.name: Silla-Tang War
wars.outcome: Silla victory: Maeso (September 675) a Tang defeat per the page, Gibeolpo (November 676); Silla controls the peninsula south of the Taedong.

certainty.note: Goguryeo outline; occupation lines moved with the revolts.
The Taedong River line, the frontier Silla won and the Tang recognised in 736.
